rationale: The original entry premise of holding above the 5m 9-EMA ($15.11) with ascending lows has broken down. The most recent 1-minute candle dropped sharply from $15.19 to close on its low of $15.09 on a heavy volume spike (34,205 shares vs. ~3,000–9,000 on prior bars), indicating strong distribution after failing to sustain new highs at $15.23. Closing now avoids taking a full stop-out at $15.01 while avoiding a short flip into the wider upward trend above VWAP ($14.85).
